note: Mauritius, read on the Economic Development Board's residency portal (residency.mu) on 2026-10-30, its fees in US dollars as from 11 July 2022. A professional employed by a local or multinational company, at a basic salary of at least MUR 50,000 a month, holds an Occupation Permit for up to 10 years depending on the contract of employment (read as work for the employer), renewable with a renewed contract; the application fee rises with the permit's length, from USD 400 for not more than 2 years (kept with that term) to USD 1,000 for more than 5 and up to 10 years, and a short-term permit of up to 9 months costs USD 300. A self-employed person investing at least USD 50,000 holds a 10-year Occupation Permit, renewable, for USD 1,000 on approval. A 20-year Permanent Residence Permit, renewable for another 20, may be asked after 5 years on an Occupation Permit (a professional earning at least MUR 400,000 a month, a self-employed person with MUR 3 million a year in business income) within 6 months of meeting the criteria; its fee is shown as an image the text doesn't carry. Where an application is made isn't said (either; the permanent permit read as applied for in Mauritius). The years naturalisation asks aren't on these pages.

sources.title: Economic Development Board Mauritius, Permanent Residence Permit (PRP)
sources.said: It is a 20-year residency, open to investors, retirees, professionals, self-employed entrepreneurs, and their family. ... renewable for another 20 years, provided the residency requirements have been fulfilled. ... Self-Employed: Holds an OP as self-employed for at least 5 years with an annual business income of at least MUR 3 million for the 5 consecutive years, immediately preceding the application for the PRP
